messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - 503 spike detected in west1. Creating #incident-503-west1 and paging current on-call. Estimated customers affected: ~120 sessions. Please ack.

Samir Patel: Ack. I'm primary on-call until 23:45 UTC, picking up driver. Observed 503 rate ~12% last 5m, errors tied to edge LB 503 upstream.

Priya Nair: Incoming at 23:40 UTC. I can take comms owner for the handoff at 23:42 UTC if Samir wants to stay driving. Will prepare status update for SRE channel and customers.

Samir Patel: Yeah please take comms, thanks. Quick notes: cache warmers running, KV cache hit down from 95% to 68. No config changes; suspect a rollout on dedicated capacity. Logs show repeated 'upstream reset' from model-worker-*/pod.

Mateo Ruiz: Jumping in to help triage. Nominating `model-worker-west1-3` as suspect. Running quick check:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep model-worker-west1
kubectl logs model-worker-west1-3 -n inference --tail=200
```
Found oomkills on that pod ~23:27 UTC and restart loop.

Samir Patel: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/503-spike. Steps taken so far:
- scaled down suspect deployment to drain
- removed node from LB
- activated dedicated-fallback route to smaller model (q4b-compat) for 20% traffic
- opened DM with infra for node investigation

Priya Nair: For handoff: I'll post a brief in the incident channel with current customer impact and mitigation plan at 23:42. Samir, please confirm who is primary driver after 23:45. Also need to note coverage gap: APAC testers may be offline between 00:00-01:00 UTC.

Samir Patel: I will remain driver for next 20 minutes to finish draining & confirm error rate drop below 1%. After that, if still stable, Mateo will hold for any deep-dive and Priya will be comms. If it flares back, re-escalate to oncall-lead (Tess).

Tess (oncall lead): Noted. If you need escalation to infra, tag me and I'll open a bridge. Also ensure to set `incident_severity` in the incident ticket to P1 and add customer list for TL contacts.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff reminder: Priya will be primary comms at 23:42 UTC; Samir remains driver until 23:55 UTC. Next scheduled on-call is Mateo from 00:00 UTC.

Priya Nair: Doing final prep for customer update: drafting bullets, will include fallback routing and ETA for rollback. Anyone object to me posting a targeted message to top customers now?

Samir Patel: Go ahead. I'll attach current error graphs and pod logs. :thumbsup:

Mateo Ruiz: I'll monitor pod restart trends and be ready to take driver if Samir has to step away. Added a probe to alert channel for restarts >3 in 5m.

incident-bot: All actions logged in #incident-503-west1. Please ack in thread when you have the handoff confirmed.

Samir Patel: Handback acked. Leaving comms to Priya, driver til 23:55.

Priya Nair: Ack. Posting update now.
